scripts.export:build: next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('build')) fs.rmSync('build',{recursive:true,force:true}); if(!fs.existsSync('out')){console.error('Missing out/ - export failed'); process.exit(1);} fs.cpSync('out','build',{recursive:true}); console.log('Static site prepared in build/');"
